clauses.reason: Section 3 authorizes the Secretary of the Navy and the Secretary of the department in which the Coast Guard is operating to exempt, in accord with Rule 38, vessels whose keel was laid before July 15, 1977 from full compliance, provided they comply with the 1960 Regulations. The July 15, 1977 date defines the class of vessels that may be exempted; it is not a date on which the authority ends. The held text of Rule 38 of the Convention is not among the held sources, so whether any exemption could still be granted today is not shown; the clause is treated as operative because no held instrument or own term ends it and the Code note still prints it. Operative on 2026-10-14.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (42 FR 4327, January 24, 1977; jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11964.txt) is Executive Order 11964 of January 19, 1977, Implementation of the Convention on the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, 1972, issued under Section 301 of Title 3 of the United States Code to provide for the Convention's coming into force on July 15, 1977. Inventory: Section 1(a), 1(b), 1(c), 2, 3 and 4 as in the dossier; the preamble is not an operative clause. The order has no sunset, expiry date or condition. Later instruments: none was found. The OFR catalog search returned 0 hits, the U.S. Code search returned the Code note above (no amendment note), and the held texts that cite the order by number are the OFR 1989 codification, the 1977 Federal Register copy, a Department of the Navy notice of November 10, 2022 (87 FR 67875) that applies Section 1 by finding that a vessel of the Navy is of special construction or purpose, and regulation texts (33 CFR 26.02, Parts 81 and 82) that cite the order as authority. Current law: the Code note is the held CURRENT record; read with the three bounded searches it supports operative status of every clause on 2026-10-14. Coverage notes read: U.S. Code through 2026-10-09 only; eCFR as of 2026-10-14; OFR catalog and saved texts checked 2026-11-25.
